title: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomatoes, simmer. Toss with pasta and torn basil. Season to taste.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry sliced chicken in oil. Add garlic and ginger, then sliced bell pepper and onion. Splash soy sauce, cook until crisp-tender.

title: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs, season. Sauté vegetables in butter, add eggs, cook until set.
